summary: The study investigates the nucleation and growth of HfO2 films deposited by ALD on different Si substrates, focusing on the microstructural evolution using GISAXS. The films grown on H-terminated Si show greater scattering and porosity compared to those on chemically oxidized Si.
evidence: We report the results of grazing incidence small angle x-ray scattering experiments on the nucleation and growth of atomic layer deposited HfO2 films. ... Growth on hydrogen terminated Si, characterized by few Si–OH groups, resulted in parabolic growth behavior, islanded growth and rough films. ... Two sets of ALD HfO2 films were grown, on Chemox or H-term Si, at 300 °C using HfCl4 and H2O, on 200 mm Si wafers.
